Child rights activists say that the culture surrounding disciplining children in Indian society legitimises violence and abuse. File photo |Photo credit: K. Ananthan | Photo Credit: K_Ananthan
Despite her mother’s constant efforts, 14-year-old Anamika (name changed) did not want to go to her school for a week. “Her maths teacher used to hit students constantly. My daughter was sick and missed a few classes and did not do an assignment; she was hit badly. It affected her mental health, and she was not able to handle the pressure,” her mother, Anu, said. She wanted to file a complaint, but the teacher threatened to fail her daughter. Anamika, a Class 9 student, studies in a government girls’ school in Chennai. After a few parents in a meeting said they would raise the complaint with the police, the teacher stopped hitting the students.
